content.comment_body: I'm having trouble connecting to my [product_name] [article_no] module. I'm using [product_name] [version_no]. The module IP is 192.168.0.3 with subnet 255.255.255.0. My PC's IP is 192.168.0.7, same subnet. I can successfully ping the module via command prompt, but when I try to go online, the module appears unreachable (red question mark) and doesn't show up when refreshing online settings. Although it lets me attempt a connection, it still isn't visible in the accessible devices window. What could be the cause?
Hello [user_name], please avoid posting multiple threads for the same issue.

This topic is closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'Module is unreachable' has been published within the '[product_name] - Software' category. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user is able to ping the [product_name] module on the network. However, [product_name] [version_no] software does not detect the device as accessible, despite confirmed network connectivity. This causes confusion and frustration since the device remains absent from the accessible devices window.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects reliable detection and seamless connection to the device within [product_name] [version_no] after verifying network connectivity.
